claims.statement: The backup-email guide applies to FPT, GHES and GHEC. Its introduction describes an additional destination for security-relevant account notifications and password reset when the primary address is inaccessible; it does not establish bypass of 2FA or complete account recovery.

The settings includes open Settings and Emails; the procedure selects an address in the Backup email address dropdown then Save. It does not supply address-addition, verification or delivery-testing steps.

Configured backup destination, current mailbox access, actual security-message delivery and successful authorized recovery are separate observations. The page alone cannot certify any target's recovery readiness.

The linked reference requires separate review; no backup address, credential or recovery state is changed. Broad product metadata provides no independently verified managed-user self-service exception.
